subject: Compact demo: squeeze and coverage options

Subject: Compact demo: squeeze and coverage options

Hi Natalie / Samir —

Thanks for agreeing to a product walk-through. Per our conversation, I scheduled a 60-minute demo on Wednesday, May 5 at 11:00 AM PT so we can cover integration patterns, inference cost controls, and a short Q&A. I've attached a short agenda (demo_agenda.pdf).

If that slot ends up tight on your side, we can:
- compress to a 30-minute focused session (exec + AE + SE) covering priority use cases, or
- move to a slightly later date (May 7) if that works better for stakeholders.

Dylan (AE) and our SE will be on the call — Marissa is tentatively assigned. If anything changes on your side, tell me which option you prefer and we'll adjust.

Thanks — look forward to it.

Best,

Thanks for the quick note, Natalie — that's helpful. Two workable approaches from our side:

Option A — Compressed 30-min (Thu May 6, 10:00 AM PT):
- Focus on 3 areas: 1) integration pattern (10m), 2) live inference demo + latency/cost summary (12m), 3) next steps & Qs (8m).
- We can have Dylan (AE), a single SE, and your exec + Samir.

Option B — Move to Fri May 7 morning for 45–60 min to keep the deeper walkthrough and more stakeholders.

Marissa is our primary SE on the account (cc'd). If Marissa is traveling, we can also bring Connor to run the compressed session — either way we'll make sure the SE has the right environment and the short one-pager.

Which do you prefer? If compressed is best, I will switch the invite and confirm the attendee list.

Cheers,
Stephanie
